## How did you test it?

Describe the checks you ran. Include screenshots for visible changes and remove private content.

- [ ] I updated the docs if commands, defaults, or setup changed.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/iamrajjoshi/cliplink/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for local checks. Please use [private security reporting](https://github.com/iamrajjoshi/cliplink/security/advisories/new) for suspected vulnerabilities.
